baseline.source: canon: WFB Dogs of War / Tilea (independent city-states ruled by merchant princes, mercenary companies, Myrmidia cult)
baseline.why: Tilean city-states are ruled by merchant princes with the great houses (monarchy + oligarchy, no elections), hire professional mercenary companies and trade under mercantilist rules Taxed goods are liquor, not wine: the check in validate_taxed_goods.py finds no vineyard in the tag's own market, while subsistence home workshops make liquor everywhere (#6638 phase A).

taxed_goods.source: derived: validate_taxed_goods.py finds a building_vineyard in this tag's own states
taxed_goods.why: Keeps wine, the good its market produces at the start, while the region's other tags tax liquor.

REM.note: Republic (non-tabletop sources); a council of merchant families (#8459); the other Tilean cities are merchant-prince ruled.

laws.lawgroup_governance_principles.source: non-tabletop: Warhammer Online lore page (everquest.allakhazam.com/wiki/tilea_(war_lore)) and a 2007 Wikipedia 'Tilea' mirror call Remas and Verezzo republics; loremaster 2026-10-24 (wiki-rank source, confidence medium): Remas is ruled by a council of merchant families, with a triumvirate chosen by lot
laws.lawgroup_governance_principles.why: A parliamentary republic: the council of merchant families, not a president.

laws.lawgroup_distribution_of_power.source: non-tabletop: Warhammer Online lore page (everquest.allakhazam.com/wiki/tilea_(war_lore)) and a 2007 Wikipedia 'Tilea' mirror call Remas and Verezzo republics; approved by Chris 2026-10-23
laws.lawgroup_distribution_of_power.why: Wealth voting: the propertied houses elect the magistrates.

next_election.why: Starting elections are spread over four dates (REM, MAR, MOO, VER) so they do not fall on one day; #6640 governs how they run.

laws.lawgroup_slavery.source: canon: WFB (Pirates of Sartosa, raiders and slavers); TW:WH2 (Pirates of Sartosa)

laws.lawgroup_church_and_state.why: A haven of many peoples keeps no state cult.

laws.lawgroup_policing.why: No organised police in a pirate republic.

laws.lawgroup_education_system.why: No schools in a pirate republic.

laws.lawgroup_taxation.why: A flavour choice, not a tech limit: the southern preset has currency_standards, but the haven levies harbour dues on goods rather than a head tax.

ruling_igs.source: canon: WFB Pirates of Sartosa (captains and brokers)
ruling_igs.why: Captains and merchant-brokers share the take.

institutions.source: derived: an institution exists only under a law that names it (law_no_schools, law_no_health_system and law_no_police grant none)
institutions.why: Drops the institution level the baseline would give; #9036.

SRT.note: A council of captains under a pirate prince; inherits the Tilean baseline.

laws.lawgroup_church_and_state.source: derived: effect_starting_technology_kislev_tech lacks rationalism, which law_freedom_of_conscience needs (#8459)
laws.lawgroup_church_and_state.why: Uvetovsk's Kislevite culture starts without rationalism, so it keeps the established church; the other Border Princes (southern preset) keep freedom of conscience.
